CUT01｜00:00–00:02.5｜Visuals：白いスケッチブックのような背景。画面中央に、手書き風の丸っこいミニマル主人公が立っている。頭は丸、手足はシンプル、顔は小さな目と口だけの親しみやすいデザイン。最初は少しぼんやりした表情。周囲に小さく手書き文字で「ふー」「ぼんやり」「まだかな」が漂う。背景には薄いドットと落書きの丸、短い線。｜Camera：50mm相当、正面のミディアムショット、ゆっくり軽く寄る。｜Motion：主人公は静かに立って、ほんの少しだけ体を揺らす程度。まだ踊っていない。目線が左右に小さく動く。｜Lighting：明るいハイキー。紙の質感がうっすら見える柔らかな光。｜VFX：手書き線のラフな揺れ、インクの少しのにじみ、薄いハーフトーン。｜BGM：明るいポップエレクトロ開始。150〜160BPM。冒頭は軽いクリック、マレット、柔らかいキックのみで静かにスタート。｜SFX：ペンの「しゅっ」、小さな「ふわっ」。｜Emotion：まだ静か、始まりの余白。｜Transition：主人公の足元に小さくピンクの「とん」が現れ、次CUTへ。 CUT02｜00:02.5–00:05.0｜Visuals：主人公の足元に「とん」「るん」「ぱっ」がカラフルな手書き文字で次々に出現。色はピンク、シアン、イエロー、オレンジ、ライム、パープル。周囲には手描きの星、音符、矢印が増え始める。背景のドットも少し濃くなる。｜Camera：35mm相当、やや引いて全身が見える構図。軽く左右にスライド。｜Motion：主人公がまず片足で「とん」、次に肩を「るん」と弾ませ、最後に「ぱっ」で小さく腕を広げる。まだ控えめだが、踊り始めたことがわかる。｜Lighting：明るく軽やか。｜VFX：文字が書かれながら出るアニメーション、軽い残像、カラフルなスパーク。｜BGM：ハイハットとクラップが追加される。ビートが前に出て、踊りのきっかけを作る。｜SFX：「とん」「るん」「ぱっ」。｜Emotion：ちょっと楽しい、気分が上がり始める。｜Transition：足元の「るん」が跳ねて上に飛び、主人公の周囲を回りながら次CUTへ。 CUT03｜00:05.0–00:08.0｜Visuals：主人公の周囲に「わく」「にこっ」「くるっ」「きらっ」「いいね」が手書き文字でリズミカルに出現。背景には手描きの音符、稲妻、丸囲み、吹き出し、放射線。全体がカラフルなポップアート風に一気に華やぐ。｜Camera：28mm相当、全身を追いながら軽い回り込み。｜Motion：主人公が本格的に踊り始める。ステップを踏み、肩を揺らし、腕を左右に振り、最後に「くるっ」で一回転。回転に合わせて周囲の文字も一緒に回る。｜Lighting：中盤の盛り上がりとしてもっとも色が映える明るさ。｜VFX：回転の文字軌道、ドットの拡大縮小、コミック風スパーク、マーカー線の勢い。｜BGM：ベースとシンセ刻みが入り、テンションを1段アップ。リズムが弾み、ダンスが見て気持ちよいポイント。｜SFX：「たんっ」「くるっ」「きらっ」「にこっ」。｜Emotion：完全に楽しくなってくる。｜Transition：一回転した主人公の周囲にカラフルな文字の円ができ、その円が画面全体に広がって次CUTへ。 CUT04｜00:08.0–00:11.0｜Visuals：主人公のダンスに合わせて、背景そのものが踊り出す。手書きの「るん♪」「わくわく」「ぱっ」「たんっ」「GO!」が画面全体に散り、落書きの矢印や音符や星もリズムに合わせて弾む。世界全体が“今日が踊っている”ように見える。｜Camera：24mm相当、少し引きで全体を見せつつ、ビートに合わせて小さく前後する。｜Motion：主人公が左右へ2ステップ、ジャンプ、着地、両腕を上げる。背景の文字と落書きも同時に上下左右へ弾み、主人公と一緒に踊る。｜Lighting：高キーでポップ、クライマックス感のある抜けた明るさ。｜VFX：手書き線の弾性変形、紙吹雪のような文字片、ハーフトーンドットの切り替え、放射線の点滅。｜BGM：ここが最大の盛り上がり。シンセが開き、クラップが増え、ビートが最も跳ねる。｜SFX：「ぽん！」「たんっ！」「しゃらん！」「るん♪」。｜Emotion：心が弾けるピーク。｜Transition：踊っていた文字たちが一斉に主人公の周囲へ集まり、中央へ吸い込まれていく。 CUT05｜00:11.0–00:13.2｜Visuals：これまで踊っていたカラフルな手書き文字が渦になり、中央で「もしも、」「今日が」「踊ったら？」の断片を一瞬ずつ作る。背景の落書きは少し整理され、メッセージが見え始める。主人公は中央手前で最後のダンスの締めに入る。｜Camera：40mm相当、主人公と文字渦が見える中央構図、ゆっくり寄る。｜Motion：主人公が小さくターンして、片手を上げ、片足を出した決めポーズに入る寸前まで動く。文字は渦を巻きながら気持ちよく整列していく。｜Lighting：安定感ある明るさ、ラストに向けて整理された空気。｜VFX：手書きの文字渦、描き直される線、軽い発光感、ポップな飛沫。｜BGM：ここで一瞬だけ音数を減らし、ブレイクを作る。ラストメッセージ前の“ため”。｜SFX：「しゅるるる」「すっ」「きゅん」。｜Emotion：期待感、決めの直前。｜Transition：最後の文字線が引かれて完成へ。 CUT06｜00:13.2–00:15.0｜Visuals：画面中央に大きく、カラフルな手書き文字で「もしも、今日が踊ったら？」を完成表示。文字はマーカー風の多色使いだが、太めの黒フチでしっかり読める。下に小さく「るん♪」。主人公は横または手前で、片足を上げた楽しいダンスの決めポーズ。周囲には音符、星、丸、矢印がふわっと漂う。｜Camera：50mm相当、固定でしっかり見せる。｜Motion：主人公が最後に小さく1回だけ弾み、ウインクまたはにっこり笑う。「るん♪」も一緒に少し跳ねる。｜Lighting：爽やかなハイキー、余韻重視。｜VFX：ごく軽い余韻粒子、手書き線の残像、薄いドット背景。｜BGM：メッセージ完成と同時に明るいコードを一発入れ、最後はポップで気持ちよく着地。｜セリフなし｜　SFX：「ぽん♪」。｜Emotion：見終わった瞬間に気分が上がる、前向きでハッピーな余韻。｜Transition：白残しフェードアウト。 全体演出ルール｜Visuals：主人公は“手書き風の丸っこいミニマルキャラ”で、踊りが見やすいようにシンプルな形を保つ。文字は主人公の感情とリズムを表す演出として使い、世界そのものも少しずつ踊り出す構成にする。｜Color：ビビッドピンク、シアン、イエロー、オレンジ、ライム、パープルを基調にしたカラフルなポップアート配色。ポジティブな文字ほど鮮やかにする。｜Motion：主人公のダンスは、最初は小さく、途中で軽快に、最後は決めポーズまでしっかり見せる。文字は跳ねる、回る、書かれる、散る、集まる、を0.2〜0.6秒単位で細かく変化させる。｜Typography：手書き感を重視しつつ、日本語は文字化けなく正確に表示。ラストコピー「もしも、今日が踊ったら？」は特に可読性を最優先。｜BGM：明るい高速ポップエレクトロ。150〜160BPM前後。静かな導入→中盤加速→クライマックスで最大化→終盤で一瞬ためて→ラストで気持ちよく着地。｜SFX：書く音、ポップ音、ジャンプ音、ベル風のキラキラ音を要所で入れ、ダンスの動きと気持ちよく同期させる。

promptTranslations.en: CUT01 | 00:00–00:02.5 | Visuals: White sketchbook-like background. In the center of the screen stands a hand-drawn, rounded, minimalist main character. Round head, simple limbs, an approachable design with just tiny eyes and a mouth. Initially a slightly absentminded expression. Small handwritten words like "ふー" (phew), "ぼんやり" (spacing out), and "まだかな" (not yet?) drift around. In the background are faint dots, doodle circles, and short lines. | Camera: 50mm equivalent, front medium shot, slowly and gently pushing in. | Motion: The protagonist stands quietly, only slightly swaying their body. Not dancing yet. Line of sight shifts slightly left and right. | Lighting: Bright high-key. Soft light revealing a faint paper texture. | VFX: Rough wobble of hand-drawn lines, slight bleeding of ink, faint halftones. | BGM: Bright pop-electro begins. 150–160 BPM. Quietly starts with just light clicks, mallets, and a soft kick at the beginning. | SFX: "Whoosh" of a pen, subtle "poof". | Emotion: Still quiet, empty space of the beginning. | Transition: A small pink "とん" (tap) appears at the protagonist's feet, leading to the next CUT. CUT02 | 00:02.5–00:05.0 | Visuals: Colorful handwritten words "とん" (tap), "るん" (hum/skip), and "ぱっ" (pop) appear one after another at the protagonist's feet. Colors are pink, cyan, yellow, orange, lime, and purple. Hand-drawn stars, musical notes, and arrows begin to multiply in the surroundings. Background dots also become slightly darker. | Camera: 35mm equivalent, slightly pulled back framing showing full body. Light slide left and right. | Motion: The protagonist first taps with one foot ("とん"), then bounces their shoulders with "るん", and finally opens their arms slightly with "ぱっ". Still restrained, but clearly starting to dance. | Lighting: Bright and lighthearted. | VFX: Animation of text being written out as it appears, light afterimages, colorful sparks. | BGM: Hi-hats and claps are added. The beat comes forward, triggering the dance. | SFX: "とん" (tap), "るん" (hum), "ぱっ" (pop). | Emotion: A bit fun, mood starting to lift. | Transition: The "るん" at the feet bounces upward, circling around the protagonist toward the next CUT. CUT03 | 00:05.0–00:08.0 | Visuals: Handwritten words "わく" (excited), "にこっ" (smile), "くるっ" (twirl), "きらっ" (sparkle), "いいね" (nice) appear rhythmically around the protagonist. In the background, hand-drawn musical notes, lightning bolts, circled shapes, speech bubbles, and radial lines appear. The entire scene bursts into a colorful pop-art style all at once. | Camera: 28mm equivalent, lightly orbiting while tracking the full body. | Motion: Protagonist starts dancing in earnest. Stepping, swaying shoulders, swinging arms left and right, and finally spinning around with "くるっ". The surrounding text spins along with the rotation. | Lighting: Brightness where colors pop most vibrantly as the mid-section buildup. | VFX: Orbiting paths of rotating text, expanding/shrinking dots, comic-style sparks, energetic marker strokes. | BGM: Bass and rhythmic synth chops enter, raising tension by one level. The rhythm bounces, creating a visually satisfying groove for the dance. | SFX: "たんっ" (tap), "くるっ" (twirl), "きらっ" (sparkle), "にこっ" (smile). | Emotion: Fully becoming fun and lively. | Transition: A circle of colorful text forms around the spun protagonist, and that circle expands across the entire screen into the next CUT. CUT04 | 00:08.0–00:11.0 | Visuals: In sync with the protagonist's dance, the background itself begins to dance. Handwritten "るん♪", "わくわく" (thrilling), "ぱっ", "たんっ", "GO!" scatter across the entire screen; doodle arrows, musical notes, and stars bounce to the rhythm. The whole world looks as if "Today is dancing." | Camera: 24mm equivalent, slightly wide to show the whole picture, gently pushing in and out to the beat. | Motion: Protagonist takes two steps left and right, jumps, lands, and raises both arms. Background text and doodles simultaneously bounce up, down, left, and right, dancing along with the protagonist. | Lighting: High-key and pop, open and exhilarating brightness with a climactic feel. | VFX: Elastic deformation of hand-drawn lines, confetti-like text fragments, switching halftone dots, flashing radial burst lines. | BGM: Maximum peak excitement here. Synths open up, claps increase, and the beat bounces at its peak. | SFX: "ぽん！" (pop!), "たんっ！" (tap!), "しゃらん！" (shimmer!), "るん♪". | Emotion: Peak of heart-fluttering joy. | Transition: The dancing text gathers all at once around the protagonist, getting sucked into the center. CUT05 | 00:11.0–00:13.2 | Visuals: The colorful handwritten text that was dancing swirls into a vortex, momentarily assembling fragments of "もしも、" (what if), "今日が" (today), "踊ったら？" (danced?) in the center. The background doodles become somewhat organized, and the message begins to emerge. Protagonist in the center foreground enters the final wrap-up of the dance. | Camera: 40mm equivalent, center framing showing protagonist and text vortex, slowly pushing in. | Motion: Protagonist makes a small turn, moving right up to the moment of entering the final pose with one hand raised and one leg stepped forward. The text neatly and satisfyingly aligns while swirling. | Lighting: Grounded brightness, clean atmosphere toward the finale. | VFX: Hand-drawn text vortex, redrawn lines, soft glow, pop splatters. | BGM: Instruments briefly drop out here to create a break. A momentary "pause/anticipation" before the final message. | SFX: "Shurururu", "su-", "kyun". | Emotion: Anticipation, right before the finale pose. | Transition: The final stroke of text is drawn, leading to completion. CUT06 | 00:13.2–00:15.0 | Visuals: Large, colorful handwritten text "もしも、今日が踊ったら？" appears fully formed in the center of the screen. The text uses multicolor marker-style rendering with a thick black outline for solid legibility. Below it in small lettering: "るん♪". The protagonist strikes a fun final dance pose beside or in front of it with one leg lifted. Musical notes, stars, circles, and arrows float gently in the surroundings. | Camera: 50mm equivalent, static shot to present clearly. | Motion: Protagonist does one final subtle bounce, winks or smiles brightly. "るん♪" also bounces slightly alongside. | Lighting: Refreshing high-key, emphasizing lingering resonance. | VFX: Extremely subtle lingering particles, afterimages of hand-drawn lines, faint dot background. | BGM: A bright chord hits at the exact moment the message completes, landing cleanly with a pop, satisfying finish. | No dialogue | SFX: "ぽん♪" (pop♪). | Emotion: An uplifting, positive, and happy afterglow the moment viewing finishes. | Transition: Fade out leaving white space. Overall Direction Rules | Visuals: The protagonist is a "hand-drawn, rounded minimalist character," keeping a simple shape to ensure dance movements are easy to follow. Text serves as visual direction to express the protagonist's emotions and rhythm, structured so the world itself gradually starts dancing. | Color: A colorful pop-art palette based on vivid pink, cyan, yellow, orange, lime, and purple. The more positive the text, the more vibrant its color. | Motion: The protagonist's dance is small at first, light on its feet midway through, and firmly shown all the way to the final pose. Text details shift rapidly in 0.2 to 0.6-second units: bouncing, spinning, being drawn, scattering, and converging. | Typography: Prioritize a hand-drawn feel while displaying Japanese text accurately without corruption. Readability of the final copy "もしも、今日が踊ったら？" is top priority. | BGM: Bright, fast-paced pop-electro. Around 150–160 BPM. Quiet intro → mid-song acceleration → max climax → brief suspenseful pause near the end → clean, pleasant landing at the finish. | SFX: Writing sounds, pops, jumps, and bell-like sparkles inserted at key moments, cleanly synced with dance movements.

summaryTranslations.en: A timecoded video prompt featuring a hand-drawn character dancing joyfully alongside text and doodles against a sketchbook-style background.

summary: スケッチブック風の背景で手書きキャラクターが文字や落書きと共に楽しく踊る、タイムコード付きの映像プロンプト。
summaryEn: A detailed multi-shot video prompt for a hand-drawn character dancing with animated typography and pop-art doodles on paper.
